title: Invoice collection deadlines and combined instruction expenses
topic: Invoice collection deadlines and combined instruction expenses
applicability: Supplier payment instructions and merchant application bought from one operating account.
content: Customer collection deadlines refer to actual commercial invoice application, not sending-bank settlement. Application fees and all original authority application/reservation fees share the stated combined customer ceiling; the original authority sublimit also remains applicable. An authorization application already paid before an account timetable changes remains a real expense. Faster application can justify a different same-entity account and therefore a different bound beneficiary on the approved instruction. A valid but slow service may miss the invoice commitment. An immediate service remains bank-supported even where its fee makes the overall instruction unaffordable under the customer limit.

provenance.boundary: Synthetic commercial value dates, processing services, commissioning slots and old-order claim terms. Original source identity, legal-entity, equipment compatibility and marketplace rights remain governed by their original product documents.
